lessons.initialExpression: Find the nth term of a linear sequence
lessons.objective: Use the common difference and first term to build a linear position-to-term rule.
prerequisites: Continue an arithmetic sequence using its constant difference.

tutorNotes.observe: Pause after each change. Ask the student to explain the table or graph.
tutorNotes.misconception: Using the common difference as the whole nth-term rule, or treating n as the previous term.
tutorNotes.checkQuestion: Why does multiplying the position by the common difference sometimes need an extra adjustment?

steps.title: Read positions and terms
steps.explanation: Here n means the position, starting at 1. We want a rule that gives the term value directly from its position.

steps.title: Find the common difference
steps.explanation: Each term changes by {{difference}}. This is the coefficient of n in a linear position-to-term rule.
